svg.title: IconDiceFace
svg.desc: explorer.html ICON.dice: the recipe portrait's reroll button. A literal die face - a rounded square with four pips. The mockup draws it as a <rect> plus four filled <circle>s; both are written out as paths here since StreamGeometry expresses neither. The pips are stroked rather than filled (a Path.ico is one stroke), so they read as four small rings at 15px - close enough that the glyph is unmistakably a die, which the circular-arrow IconReroll it replaces was not.
